scenario.goal_zh: 确认所需工具并约好一起固定架子

context_zh: 室友借合适的工具合作固定松动的架子支架，并在收回工具前检查结果。
author: author-phase04-c

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: This shelf bracket is loose. Do you have a tool that fits these screws?

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: My small screwdriver should fit. Have you taken everything off the shelf?

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Yes. Any tip for keeping the bracket in place while I tighten it?

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: An extra pair of hands would help. I'll hold it while you turn the screwdriver.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Thanks. Let's do it now, before I put the books back.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Those screws feel tight. Give the bracket a gentle shake now. Does it still move?

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: No, it stays in place. Thanks. I'll return your screwdriver before I put the books back.
